en: Black‑and‑white postcard depicting a large medieval hilltop castle with massive plain walls and a single tall round tower rising near the center. The castle stands on a steep grassy slope with a straight stairway leading up the hill. Trees and foliage frame the right side and background, and the sky is partly cloudy. There is a narrow vertical strip on the right with some handwritten or printed numbers, but no visible title on the image side.
